reasoning: The Van der Waerden number W(3,3)=27 means that any 3-coloring of {1,...,27} must contain a monochromatic arithmetic progression of length 3. Since 54 ≥ 27, it is impossible to color {1,...,54} with 3 colors while avoiding all monochromatic APs of length 3. This was confirmed by a SAT solver (Glucose3) which returned UNSAT for the constraint system.
